basic_info.description: 2738 Great Hwy delivers exquisite coastal living w/ Old World European vibes. This stunning home w/ocean views on 2 levels was impeccably remodeled top to bottom in 2022 by designers Saffron + Poe and was featured in two Sunset magazine articles. Rarely does a home of this quality & views become available w/ a Great Hwy address. Stroll up the wide-plank oak stairs into the true heart of the home: the California Casual great room. The kitchen, living & dining room flow seamlessly providing ideal form & function. Showstopper kitchen has counter-to-ceiling oak cabinetry, soapstone & Michelangelo Calacatta countertops, marble backsplash, Viking range & large island. The living room has a bay window, bench/daybed w/ storage & stunning modern gas fireplace wall w/ plaster arches. Upstairs are 3 bedrooms, incl/ primary ensuite sanctuary w/large walk-in closet. Out back is a unique pocket patio that truly maximizes outdoor living space. The focal point is the outdoor shower made of green Field Tile & vintage brass & copper hardware. Cook a meal in the outdoor kitchen and wind down & warm up at night in the cedar hot tub w/radial sunburst steps that do double duty as seating. Attached garage large enough to fit 2 SUVs. Unbeatable location, this home delivers on the Ocean Beach life dream.
